mapper.select: SELECT enrollment.user_id, SUM(progress.progress_percent) AS learning_points FROM learning_course_enrollment enrollment INNER JOIN learning_chapter_progress progress ON progress.enrollment_id = enrollment.id WHERE enrollment.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY enrollment.user_id HAVING SUM(progress.progress_percent) > 0 ORDER BY learning_points DESC, enrollment.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
